deliverables.purpose: 中文主视觉海报，定义桥水巷商品系统主题

deliverables.purpose: 英文传播海报，服务国际游客与双语传播
deliverables.acceptance_test: Bakes in Collect the Bridges; stays in-system with stone-ink + wall-paper + ginkgo-ochre and does not mirror 02 line-for-line.

deliverables.purpose: 旅行贴纸与票签套组，提供低单价高传播零售品类

deliverables.purpose: 景区零售场景应用图，验证系统在真实旅游触点中的表现

deliverables.purpose: 系统情绪板，汇总色彩、字体层级、纹样与商品矩阵
deliverables.acceptance_test: Shows at least five system ingredients: palette, typography, motif, merchandise categories, day-night contrast; anchored by river-jade + wall-paper + stone-ink.

deliverables.purpose: 单页展示最终PNG集、设计系统上下文与参考资产来源
deliverables.acceptance_test: Embeds every required PNG in a primary Final Deliverables section; inline CSS only; no JS; shows palette swatches and typography role callouts from design_system.json at top; any research assets appear only in a secondary provenance section.
